
```{bash}
# 1. create symbolic links from SUNET drive to current working directory
PROJ="$HOME/CAPTUS_pipeline_2026"
RAW="$PROJ/data/input/input_sequences"
mkdir -p "$RAW"

src="/mnt/c/Users/frwo0304/Nextcloud_SU/2025_2030_PlantEvolutionaryBiogeography_473/01_projects/01_uapaca/sequence_data/"
dst="$RAW"

# create symbolic links for all .fastq.gz files in the source folder:
for f in "$src"/*.fastq.gz; do
    ln -s "$f" "$dst/$(basename "$f")"
done
```



```{bash}
# 2. Rename read files to match taxon names
stab="$PROJ/data/input/old_names_new_names.txt"  # look up file with old and new names
echo "INFO: Reading name mappings from: $stab"
mapfile -t old_prefix < <(tail -n +2 "$stab" | cut -f1)
mapfile -t new_name < <(tail -n +2 "$stab" | cut -f2)
echo "INFO: Found ${#old_prefix[@]} sample name mappings"



cd "$RAW"
shopt -s nullglob
for i in "${!old_prefix[@]}"; do
  old="${old_prefix[$i]}"
  new="${new_name[$i]}"
  echo "INFO: Processing sample $((i+1))/${#old_prefix[@]}: $old -> $new"

  # find paired-end files from the same sample:
  for f in "${old}"_*.fastq.gz; do
    suffix="${f#${old}}"
    target="$(readlink -f "$f")" || \
      { echo "WARNING: Failed to resolve target for $f" >&2; continue; }
    ln -sf -- "$target" "${new}${suffix}" || \
      { echo "WARNING: Failed to create symlink for $f" >&2; continue; }
    rm -f -- "$f"
  done
done

```

## Change the read files to add "R" for the reads.
```{bash}
cd /home/frieda/CAPTUS_pipeline_2026/data/input/input_sequences

for file in *_1.fastq.gz *_2.fastq.gz; do
    [ -e "$file" ] || continue
    new="${file/_1.fastq.gz/_R1.fastq.gz}"
    new="${new/_2.fastq.gz/_R2.fastq.gz}"
    mv -- "$file" "$new"
done
```


## Get & Create target file from Mega353
```{bash}
#| eval: false

# 3. set up target file from https://github.com/chrisjackson-pellicle/NewTargets
conda create --name NewTargets python=3.7
conda activate NewTargets
conda install -c anaconda biopython=1.76
conda install pandas

TARGETS="$PROJ/data/input/mega353target"

# Install repository
cd "$TARGETS"
git clone https://github.com/chrisjackson-pellicle/NewTargets.git
unzip NewTargets/mega353.fasta.zip

cat > select_file.txt <<'EOF'
[Order]
Malpighiales
EOF

python NewTargets/filter_mega353.py \
"mega353.fasta" \
"select_file.txt" \
-filtered_target_file "mega353_filtered.fasta" \
-report_filename "mega353_filter_report.txt" 
```
